scientific_integrity: Proof by complete classification of local branch images and inclusion-exclusion, with a direct small-instance exhaustive checker and a separate subset-state check. No independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not count higher-depth trees or unlabeled maps. Existence was already decided for general source trees; claimed contribution is exact labeled profile and count. An unindexed equivalent formula may exist. Small exhaustive checks are not the general proof.
scientific_scope: Surjective bounded morphisms between finite labeled rooted tree posets of exactly three levels with arbitrary positive branch-size vectors; multivariate fiber profile and exact total count.
title: Branch-use polynomial for surjective p-morphisms of three-level rooted trees
